items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: I heard it. And I taped it. I wrote them a thank-you note.

ctx.x: Well, we're becoming more and more Callender conscious here lately. I've noticed your name more and more often. A week ago Bill Green's Kansas City 7 broadcast live from the County Museum, and they played Red Callender originals.

I heard it. And I taped it. I wrote them a thank-you note. That's one of the tunes I was telling you about some time ago. It originally started as 'Dolphin Street Boogie,' and then I made a record on it... I said I was copying Duke Ellington. I did a record on it, and called it 'Dedicated To the Blues.' And now with the new title, we call it 'See You Later, So Long.' It now has a lyric.
Oh, that's the one that Mary Lou...
